acyclicity_rules: a generator may read only declared predecessor nodes
no derived output may alter an authored input, generator, scenario or oracle
SOURCE_SHA256.txt excludes itself and all derived descendants
BUILD_RECORD.json does not contain the final manifest hash, ZIP hash, wall-clock timestamp or duration
the ZIP and external sidecars remain outside the package root and outside the package manifest
build_order: validate authored source, decision, thesis and binding layers
validate and freeze input-only scenarios and independent oracles
run python3 -I -B -X utf8 scripts/verify_manifest.py --root . --manifest manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt and require exit code zero
run the reference scenario recipe and unit tests
validate coverage and all generated outputs
execute every validator_registry entry and require zero exit codes
build deterministic ZIP and its external SHA-256 sidecar
dag: frozen authored inputs plus all generator and validator files -> scripts/build_source_manifest.py
scripts/build_source_manifest.py -> manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt while excluding the manifest output itself and all derived descendants
verified manifests/SOURCE_SHA256.txt, which includes frozen scenarios and oracles, -> reference run and tests
reference run and tests -> reference-derived results, traces, rejection, logs and summaries
validated reference-derived outputs plus the internal review -> registered validators
registered validators with zero exit codes -> manifests/BUILD_RECORD.json
all package files except final manifest -> MANIFIESTO_SHA256.txt
frozen package tree -> deterministic ZIP outside package root
failure_policy: any missing predecessor, count mismatch, schema failure, hash mismatch, unresolved ledger target or nonzero command exit stops all downstream nodes
